scope: Dashboard credibility panel and offline Arabic report viewer

browser_smoke.method: Codex browser AX inspection and screenshot of locally rendered Next dashboard
states_verified: Offline camera shows unavailable/retry; no automatic demo fallback
No-data scores, decision, thresholds, subsystem health and latency are unavailable
Header does not claim two live cameras; empty incident feed does not claim monitoring active
System displays measured page-session elapsed time and categorical connection status
Offline Arabic facts-only report viewer is primary; online DeepSeek report is collapsed and optional

semantics.samples: Each score trace uses its own producer completion ID; combined or repeated render samples cannot invent per-model observations.
semantics.freshness: Five-second transport and independent completed-inference freshness; historical values remain distinguishable from current state.
semantics.confirmation: Only the backend decision contract yields CONFIRMED; scores or isThreat flags alone do not.
semantics.local_report: Read-only saved facts summary via GET /reports/local/{alertId}; exact mode/id validated, Arabic plain text escaped and RTL, no image/VLM claim.
semantics.window_clock: Window span explicitly distinguishes recorded-media time from live capture time; incomplete windows do not falsely show invalid.

limitations: Actual replay trace and saved-report ready state were not browser-verified against the integrated backend
No claim of glass-to-alert latency, calibration, full runtime gate readiness, or Arabic VLM quality
Existing NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_API_KEY authHeaders in ai-report were reused; no new credential storage or credential values introduced
